name: Portal Stat-Strip Density Harmonization (Option A)
description: Tighten existing single-row stat-strip containers (small-pill bell-curve / radial sibling pattern) across 4 portal sites to stop the 6-element variant wrapping on Surface Laptop viewports and align density across all 4 sites in lockstep. Extraction of a shared <MetricStrip> primitive (DASH_STSTRP_V2) is deferred until Option A bakes for one nightly cycle.
